source.title: A role for the claustrum in cognitive control.

confidence_rationale: This is the source thought's own central citation and the primary published articulation of the 'network instantiation' account -- direct architectural support for SD-091's parameter/topology distinction. Confidence is capped at moderate because the account is explicitly presented as a synthesis with 'testable predictions' rather than a settled mechanism, and it does not itself address the TYPED (demand-specific) recruitment MECH-481 requires -- it proposes one generic instantiation function, not a taxonomy of coalition templates.
failure_signatures: The review itself notes that prior claustrum models (salience detection, multisensory binding, top-down attention, cognitive control) were mutually incompatible and required active reconciliation -- convergence on the network-instantiation account is not yet an established consensus, only the authors' proposed synthesis.

The model specifies that frontal cortex directs claustrum-mediated network instantiation but does not specify a mechanism for how different control DEMAND TYPES would produce qualitatively different instantiated networks, which is the specific gap MECH-481 needs closed.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Frontal cortices direct the claustrum to flexibly instantiate cortical networks in the service of cognitive control -- the 'network instantiation in cognitive control' (NICC) model, proposed to reconcile prior claustrum function hypotheses (salience detection, multisensory binding, attention).
mapping.ree_translation: Direct biological analogue of SD-091's proposed second control-plane output axis: a frontally-driven mechanism that assembles a temporary functional interaction graph (G_t) is structurally what NICC describes for the claustrum. Also motivates MECH-481's claim that control-demand formation causally precedes coalition instantiation (frontal control signal -> claustrum -> cortical network), though NICC does not itself commit to a typed-demand taxonomy.
mapping.mapping_caveat: NICC is a conceptual/anatomical model, not a computational architecture -- the REE mapping from 'claustrum instantiates a cortical network' to 'control plane emits a graph-valued output G_t with persistence/dissolution conditions Gamma_t' is an explicit reinterpretation, not something the paper itself formalizes. The paper's own guardrail language (used verbatim in the source thought and carried into MECH-481's notes) explicitly disclaims that the claustrum computes metacognition -- it only proposes an enactment role. Do not read this entry as validating the specific typed-demand taxonomy (SENSORY_RESAMPLE, PROVENANCE_CHECK, etc.); that taxonomy is REE's own invention, not sourced from this paper.
mapping.source_context: Human and animal neuroanatomical/neuroimaging literature review; theoretical synthesis, not a single new dataset.

confidence_components.notes: High-quality, well-cited review from an active claustrum-research group (Mathur/Seminowicz/Krimmel lab), but the NICC model itself is a proposal awaiting the kind of falsifier MECH-481 registers, not a confirmed mechanism. Weight mapping_fidelity moderately: strong for the architectural bifurcation (parameters vs topology), weak for the typed-coalition specifics.
